key_insight: MIMIC-Note-Extract turns free-text discharge summaries into reusable structured data, expanding access to clinical information missing from or underrepresented in existing MIMIC tables.
clinical_relevance: The dataset supports research using patient histories, allergies, and diagnostic findings without requiring each project to build its own extraction pipeline.
method: Combine deterministic parsing with schema-guided LLM generation.
Extract 16 sections from 300,720 MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries into structured tables.
Use the extracted data to construct a clinical decision-making benchmark for LLM agents.
evidence_signal: Physician validation found extraction accuracy above 92% across sections; MNE provides 10 times more patient-history entries and medication histories for more than twice as many admissions.
watch_item: Extraction is not error-free, and performance beyond MIMIC discharge summaries is not established in the abstract.
paper_title: MIMIC-Note-Extract: A Large-Scale Structured Dataset Extracted from MIMIC-IV-Note Discharge Summaries
